sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The verse uses the plural "days" to include the miracle of the Splitting of the Sea, which opened a channel containing the future splitting of the sea and river.

translations.translation: And the verse is precise: "As the days of your going out from the land of Egypt,"
"Days" is plural,
that this includes also the miracle of the Splitting of the Sea of Reeds, which was on the seventh day of the Exodus from Egypt
(as above, section 2),
in order to emphasize that in the Splitting of the Sea of Reeds the channel was opened, and included within it in concealment also the splitting of the sea that will be in the future
("And Hashem will utterly destroy the tongue of the Sea of Egypt," etc.),
and even more than this—also the splitting of the river that will be in the future
("And He will wave His hand over the river, etc., and strike it into seven streams").
For although the splitting of the river is higher than the splitting of the sea,
for the splitting of the sea is the connection of Atzilus and BY"A, and the splitting of the river is the connection of the worlds
(Atzilus and BY"A)
with the Ein Sof blessed He, who is above Atzilus,
nevertheless,
in the splitting of the sea that occurred at the Exodus from Egypt, there was included in concealment the splitting of the sea of the future and also the splitting of the river of the future.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The connection of both matters is that in the future redemption, the wonders will include the splitting of the sea and river, and the channel for this was opened at the Exodus.

translations.translation: And it can be said,
that the connection of the two matters is "I will show him wonders,"
that in the wonders that will be in the future redemption there will also be the wonder of the splitting of the sea and the splitting of the river
("as the days" is plural)
and that the miracles clothed in nature will be in the manner of "I will show him,"
that is,
that in the future, nature will not conceal the miracles clothed within it, because then there will be the connection of the Ein Sof blessed He with the limitation of the nature of the world,
and this connection is through the splitting of the sea and the splitting of the river.
And the verse explains,
that this—that in the future there will be "I will show him wonders"
(regarding the two matters mentioned above)
is "as the days of your going out from the land of Egypt,"
that the opening of the channel for this was at the Exodus from Egypt.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The addition "and lead them with shoes" refers to the service of softening one's coarse nature through submission, which prepares for the connection of nature with Ein Sof.

translations.translation: A)
And it can be said,
that what the verse adds
(after it says "And He will wave His hand over the river, etc.")
"and lead them with shoes,"
is,
that just as
shoes, simply, are made from coarse leather,
and in order for the coarse leather to be fit to make a shoe from it
(a garment for the feet of a person)
it is by softening the leather from its hardness,
for the leather as it is in itself
(before they soften it),
being hard and coarse, it is impossible to bend it,
and specifically by softening it from its hardness, then it is possible to bend it and make from it the form of a shoe,
so too is it in spirituality,
that the matter of "and lead them with shoes" is that he treads upon the nature of his body and his animal soul,
whereby he softens them from their hardness, so that they are not hard as a cedar but soft as a reed.
And this is that "service" (avodah) is from the term "processing of hides" (ibud orot),
for the essence of the matter of service is that a person battles with his nature,
as explained in Tanya
regarding the matter of "one who serves G-d."
And through this, refinement is achieved
(not only in the nature of the person,
but)
also in the nature of the entire world,
for this is the matter of "one who serves G-d,"
"Elokim" has the numerical value of "haTeva" (nature),
that processing and rectification are done in the entirety of nature, which derives from the name Elokim.
And this is "And He will wave His hand over the river, etc., and lead them with shoes,"
that this—that in the future there will be the connection of the nature of the world with the Ein Sof blessed He, who is above worlds—
the preparation for which is the splitting of the river,
is through the service in the manner of acceptance of the yoke,
where one subjugates himself against his nature.
